title: The JFK Witness No One Ever Found
sources: Wikipedia, 'Babushka Lady': unidentified woman in a tan overcoat and headscarf seen in the Zapruder, Nix, Muchmore and Bell films holding a camera to her face; in 1970 Beverly Oliver claimed to be her and said she used a Yashica Super 8, a model not made until 1969; the 1979 House Select Committee photographic panel could not locate the Babushka Lady film
Mental Floss, 'Who Was the Mysterious Babushka Lady at JFK's Assassination?': she never came forward to law enforcement; her footage has never been found
The Sixth Floor Museum at Dealey Plaza (jfk.org), images of witnesses in Dealey Plaza

lines.text: She filmed the JFK assassination up close, and nobody knows who she was.
In the photos, a woman in a tan coat and headscarf
holds a camera up to her face.
People call her the Babushka Lady.
Follow for a new unsolved case every night.
In nineteen seventy, a woman said it was her,
